transcript.text: I was telling a friend about that old trip to Shanghai—funny how everyone has a different take on what the city feels like.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Back then I went down from Beijing to Shanghai by train, and it was one of those rides where the whole carriage was half-asleep.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: We also stayed in Shanghai, and honestly the hotel was fine—nothing fancy, just convenient for getting around.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My colleague Chen Ming had already booked the ticket for me—train G1 on 2025-03-02, Second Class—so I didn’t even have to think about it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And after I got back, I remember we had a home service appointment already set for 2025-03-18 in the afternoon at Room 203, Building C, West Apartment—phone on the order was 13877949128.
